description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing PCIe endpoint functionality for Broadcom iProc hardware, including configuration, address mapping, IRQ handling, and reset management.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_conf_read
methods.description: Reads a PCIe configuration register indirectly via offset.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_conf_write
methods.description: Writes to a PCIe configuration register indirectly via offset.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_map_addr
methods.description: Maps a PCIe address to outbound memory window, supporting high and low memory regions.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_unmap_addr
methods.description: Unmaps a previously mapped PCIe address, marking the outbound window as free.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_raise_irq
methods.description: Raises an interrupt of specified type (MSI, MSIX) for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_register_reset_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback function for PCIe reset events.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_ep_init
methods.description: Initializes the PCIe endpoint device, configuring mode, link, and interrupts.
